## Grading Summary

**Pairings and checks**

| Key | Record | Figures | Owner | Due | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| e1 | 1 | ✓ | — | — | All contract figures match the meeting |
| e2 | 2 | ✓ | — | — | Fall-2027 college start not needed here |
| e3 | 3 | ✓ | — | — | Nov 1 early action captured; fall 2027 start omitted |
| a1 | 6 | ✓ | — | — | $57,500 correct (post-correction) |
| a2 | 7 | ✗ | — | — | **"$200" instead of $200,000** — off by three orders of magnitude |
| a3 | 5 | ✓ | — | — | No figure needed; SEP stays open |
| i1 | 11 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | SEP letter/notice and corporate resolution omitted from description |
| i2 | 12 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Company-owned/beneficiary detail omitted but item intact |
| i3 | 9 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Correctly reassigned to Marisol; $132k/$33k correct |
| i4 | 8 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Correctly moved to Oct 9, not the 25th |
| i5 | 13 | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ | **Due date NOT_FOUND** — meeting set "before the December 8 meeting" |
| i6 | 10 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | |
| i7 | **0** | — | — | — | **Missed entirely** — Devin reading the LOC agreement for insurance/collateral/covenant terms before quotes return |

**Not-actions:** clean — none of the four declined/deferred items (SEP rollover, cash balance plan, BOE disability policy, T-bill ladder) were recorded as actions.

**Extra item:** #4 (Tess made JV soccer) is supported by the transcript at [00:01:14].

**Net:** 2 figure/date defects and 1 omission out of 13 key items.

key_items.note: $1.2M total, 3 years, milestone billing, first milestone $180,000 in November all match.
February 2027 start and $95,000-$100,000 range correct; first W-2 employee noted.
Two early action applications due November 1 captured; fall 2027 college start omitted but item is captured.
Solo 401(k) at Pellrose with 2026 total $57,500 (corrected figure, not the superseded $62,000).
Amount recorded as '$200' in both the action text and amount field; the agreed transfer was $200,000 from the Marrowgate operating account.
Discontinue SEP with no 2026 contribution; amount NOT_FOUND is acceptable since no money moves.
Devin Oakes, Tuesday the 22nd correct. Description omits the SEP discontinuance letter, participant notice and corporate resolution, but the package item is captured.
$1M and $1.5M, 10- and 15-year term, notice-and-consent in packet; Devin Oakes, Thursday October 1.
$132,000 W-2 and $33,000 employer contribution are the corrected figures; owner correctly reassigned from Anneliese to Marisol, due October 6.
Graham Tendry, age-61 estimate via member portal, due 2026-10-09 (the revised date, not the 25th).
Assumptions (58, 61, $57,500) and owner Anneliese are right, but due is NOT_FOUND; the meeting set it as ready before the December 8 meeting.
Marisol sends the Marrowgate line of credit agreement to Devin Oakes, Monday the 21st.

No record item covers Devin reading the LOC agreement for life insurance, collateral assignment or covenant requirements before the quotes return. Item 10 is Marisol's send task and is already paired with i6; its 'for review' phrasing does not stand as a separate owned task.

extra_items.note: Marisol states at [00:01:14] that Tess made JV and they are at soccer about four nights a week. Accurately transcribed life event, just not in the answer key.
